code: library(steamfinder)  action_games <- filter_games(   steam_games,   genres = "Action",   max_price = 20,   min_reviews = 100 ) free_games <- filter_games(   steam_games,   genres = "Action",   max_price = 0,   min_reviews = 100 )  budget_summary <- summarise_games(action_games) free_summary <- summarise_games(free_games)  comparison <- data.frame(   selection = c("Up to GBP 20", "Free only"),   n_games = c(budget_summary$n_games, free_summary$n_games),   median_price = c(budget_summary$median_price, free_summary$median_price),   median_positive = c(     budget_summary$median_positive_percent,     free_summary$median_positive_percent   ) ) knitr::kable(   comparison,   col.names = c("Selection", "Games", "Median price (GBP)", "Median positive (%)"),   digits = c(0, 0, 2, 1),   row.names = FALSE )
